# Set-ZbxUserMacro

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a user macro.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxUserMacro [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixUserMacro>[]> [[-Macro] <string>] [-Type <ZabbixMacroType>] [-Value <string>] [-Description <string>] [-Automatic <ZabbixMacroOrigin>] [-Config <ZabbixUserMacroConfigRequest>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A user macro is a named value, such as {$APP.PORT}, that items, triggers and other fields refer to; a host or template macro overrides a global one. The Set-ZbxUserMacro cmdlet changes the user macros given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with usermacro.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every user macro the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed user macros back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a user macro

```powershell
Get-ZbxUserMacro -Host 'web-01' -Name '{$APP.PORT}' | Set-ZbxUserMacro -Value '8443'
```

Sets the user macro {$APP.PORT} of web-01 to 8443.

### Example 2: Change a user macro and write the result

```powershell
Get-ZbxUserMacro -Host 'web-01' -Name '{$APP.PORT}' | Set-ZbxUserMacro -Value '8443' -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the user macro {$APP.PORT} of web-01 back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixUserMacro>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Macro (ByPropertyName), -Value (ByPropertyName), -Description (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixMacroType`: Bound to -Type (ByPropertyName). The macro type values: ZBX_MACRO_TYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixMacroOrigin`: Bound to -Automatic (ByPropertyName). The macro origin values: ZBX_USERMACRO_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixUserMacroConfigRequest`: Bound to -Config (ByPropertyName). config of a ZabbixUserMacroCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixUserMacro`: The user macro read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.
